description: This Java class 'MonkeyNetworkMonitor' is part of the Android Open Source Project and is responsible for monitoring network connectivity status during monkey testing runs. It listens for network state change intents, tracks elapsed times for Wi-Fi and mobile networks, and provides methods to start, stop, register, unregister, and dump network statistics.

classes.name: MonkeyNetworkMonitor
classes.description: A class that extends IIntentReceiver.Stub to monitor network connectivity changes during monkey testing, tracking the duration of network connections.

methods.name: performReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming network state change intents, updates network statistics based on current network state.

methods.name: updateNetworkStats
methods.description: Calculates time spent on each network type since last update and updates counters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes network timing variables and marks the start of monitoring.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the network monitor as a receiver with the activity manager.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Updates network statistics upon stopping the monitoring.
